unit.why: A single narrative, told by the Rozdol tsaddik himself, of his birth delayed two months in the womb to clear his mother of slander.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מפה קדוש כבוד אבא מארי
stories.end_quote: סיפר הרה״ק מראזלא פ"א ברבים זי"ע
stories.summary_en: The Rozdol rebbe tells how he began to emerge from the womb in the seventh month after his parents' wedding, but slanderers accused his mother of conceiving before marriage, so at her plea he withdrew and stayed two more months, thereby fulfilling the commandment of honouring his mother.

tags.why: Miraculous circumstances of the tsaddik's birth

tags.why: The fetus withdraws and delays its birth
